Remark
[Fundamental solution of Schrödinger's equation and time reversibility] ↗ ex:schrodinger-fundamental-solution ↗ thm:backwards-uniqueness-heat-equation 1. ch4:4.3.1-rem-1\group Fourier Transform

The fundamental solution \[ \Psi (x,t)=(4\pi it)^{-n/2}e^{i|x|^2/(4t)},\qquad t\ne 0, \] defines $u=g*\Psi $ for positive and negative times; Schrodinger evolution is time reversible, unlike heat evolution.
